meta_description:
318 likes, 27 comments - financebyanmoll on October 8, 2026: "People are frustrated and exhausted by this prolonged sideways phase in Nifty, which has lasted for almost two and a half years.

But we need to understand that these phases are a very normal part of market cycles. After a strong bull run, markets often go through consolidation, corrections, and periods of underperformance.

Eventually, valuations become attractive, pessimism fades, and the next bull run begins. This cycle has repeated itself throughout market history.

So don’t be surprised or behave as if something extraordinary is happening. This isn’t the first time, and it certainly won’t be the last.".
